Compact display rows appended to the floating corner card over the session's pane. The slot ID names the corner: top-trailing is the only card today; top-leading is reserved for a future leading card. The card's click-through, visibility, and activity presentation stay host-owned. A row may combine a host-rendered icon, compact text and status, and may be a disclosure: the summary stays a compact reading without controls, while the level Threading reveals from it may list, group and act.
